hook: Telangana schools could drop Saturdays: a *5-day* week proposal
hook_b: Telangana schools could drop Saturdays: a *5-day* week proposal
tldr: MLC Malka Komaraiah has proposed a 5-day school week with Saturday holidays in Hyderabad and other districts. The government hasn't decided.

beats.what: Teachers' MLC Malka Komaraiah submitted a proposal for a 5-day week, with Saturdays as holidays, for schools in Hyderabad and other Telangana districts.
beats.why: He cited the El Nino impact, concerns over water availability and climatic conditions (Siasat).
beats.care: Parents and students: nothing changes yet. It only applies if the state government accepts the proposal.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: This is a proposal, not an order. Siasat says the switch happens only if the government accepts it. How lost Saturday class time would be made up is not clear from the report.

cards.q: 5-day school week in Telangana: your take?
What reason did the 5-day week proposal cite?
cards.why: Komaraiah cited El Nino, water availability and climatic conditions.

viz.l: school days a week, if accepted

viz.verdict: Saturdays off for students, if the govt agrees

cover.label: school days a week, if accepted

learn.t: MLC = Member of the Legislative Council, the upper house of Telangana's legislature; Komaraiah represents teachers.

watch: Whether the School Education Department accepts, rejects or modifies the proposal.

sources.name: Siasat
sources.title: Hyderabad schools may adopt 5-day week with Saturday holidays

fact: A proposal asks Telangana schools to move to a *5-day* week, Saturdays off.
twist: The reason given isn't workload: it's El Nino, water shortages and the climate.
